content: रथिन् {%a.%} [रथ-इनि] .²1 Riding or driving in a carriage. .²2 Possessing or owning a carriage. --{%m.%} .²1 An owner of a carriage. .²2 A warrior who fights from a chariot; आत्मानं रथिनं विद्धि शरीरं रथमेव तु . बुद्धिं तु सारथिं विद्धि मनः प्रग्रहमेव च .. <ls>Kaṭh. 1. 3. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 37</ls>. .²3 A man of क्षत्रिय caste. .²4 A driver. .{@-नी@} A number of carriages or chariots.
